---

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
all <- fread(readLines("inputs.txt")[1])  # PCA_RESULTS: every PCA_M table, already concatenated
all[, input := paste(norm, feat, sep = " / ")]
# facet labels: module ids without the parameter hash
all[, NORM := sub("\\..*$", "", norm)][, FEAT := sub("\\..*$", "", feat)]
all[, basis := fifelse(grepl("nmf", pca), "NMF", "PCA")]
# localisation rows are per arm, the reference included; accuracy rows exclude it
loc <- all[metric %in% c("ipr", "ipr_floor")]
ve <- all[metric == "var_explained"]
m <- all[is_reference == FALSE & !metric %in% c("ipr", "ipr_floor", "var_explained")]
# log axes: exact agreement is 0, show it at the double-precision floor
floor_ <- 1e-16
m[, shown := pmax(value, floor_)]
# NMF is not a PCA basis (not orthogonal, not variance-ordered): per-PC and
# eigenvalue rows compare unrelated factors, so those plots leave it out
sci <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 1)
```

Each PCA arm vs `pc_exact` (dense LAPACK SVD, float64) on the same input
matrix. NMF is not a PCA basis: read only its subspace rows.

`r m[, uniqueN(pca)]` PCA modules, `r m[, uniqueN(input)]` input matrices,
`r m[, uniqueN(dataset)]` dataset(s).

## Summary

```{r}
s <- m[, .(
  `max pc_sin, PC1-10` = max(value[metric == "pc_sin" & index <= 10]),
  `subspace_sin k=10` = value[metric == "subspace_sin" & index == 10][1],
  `subspace_sin k=50` = value[metric == "subspace_sin" & index == 50][1],
  `max eig_rel_err, PC1-10` = max(value[metric == "eig_rel_err" & index <= 10])
), by = .(dataset, basis, pca, pca_params, input)]
setorder(s, dataset, basis, pca, input)
num <- names(s)[sapply(s, is.numeric)]
s[, (num) := lapply(.SD, sci), .SDcols = num]  # kable(digits=) would round 1e-13 to 0
knitr::kable(s, align = "l")
```

## Variance explained

`pc_exact`: % of the matrix's total variance per PC (bars) and cumulative (line).

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 11
if (nrow(ve) == 0) {
  cat("No `normalized_selected_h5` was given to PCA_M, so total variance is unknown.\n")
} else {
  ref <- ve[is_reference == TRUE, .(PC = index, pct = 100 * value, NORM, FEAT, input)]
  ref[, cum := cumsum(pct), by = input]
  ggplot(ref, aes(PC)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = pct), fill = "grey55", width = 0.8) +
    geom_line(aes(y = cum / 5), colour = "steelblue") +
    scale_y_continuous("% of total variance (bars)",
                       sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * 5, name = "cumulative % (line)")) +
    facet_grid(NORM ~ FEAT) +
    theme_bw()
}
```

## Per-PC loading error

sin(angle) between each PC's loadings and the reference's.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 11
ggplot(m[metric == "pc_sin" & basis == "PCA"], aes(index, shown, colour = pca, group = interaction(pca, pca_params))) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(NORM ~ FEAT) +
  labs(x = "PC", y = "sin(angle) to reference", colour = "PCA module") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Leading-subspace error

Largest principal-angle sine, leading k PCs: loadings and cell scores.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 11
sub <- m[metric %in% c("subspace_sin", "scores_sin")]
ggplot(sub, aes(index, shown, colour = pca, linetype = metric,
                group = interaction(pca, pca_params, metric))) +
  geom_line() + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(NORM ~ FEAT) +
  labs(x = "k (leading PCs)", y = "max sin(principal angle)", colour = "PCA module") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Eigenvalue error

Relative error of each PC's variance vs the reference eigenvalue.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 11
ggplot(m[metric == "eig_rel_err" & basis == "PCA"], aes(index, shown, colour = pca, group = interaction(pca, pca_params))) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(NORM ~ FEAT) +
  labs(x = "PC", y = "relative eigenvalue error", colour = "PCA module") +
  theme_bw()
```

## Loading localisation (IPR)

Effective genes per factor (1/IPR): how many genes carry its variance. Dashed:
random vector. Low values can be sparsity artefacts or single-gene noise axes,
not biology (Aparicio 2020); compare within a panel.

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 11
eff <- loc[metric == "ipr", .(PC = index, eff_genes = 1 / value, pca, pca_params, is_reference, NORM, FEAT)]
fl <- unique(loc[metric == "ipr_floor", .(NORM, FEAT, eff_floor = 1 / value)])
ggplot(eff, aes(PC, eff_genes, colour = pca, group = interaction(pca, pca_params))) +
  geom_line(aes(linewidth = is_reference)) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.2, `FALSE` = 0.4), guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(data = fl, aes(yintercept = eff_floor), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  facet_grid(NORM ~ FEAT) +
  labs(x = "factor", y = "effective genes (1/IPR)", colour = "module (thick = pc_exact)") +
  theme_bw()
```

## References

- Aparicio L et al. (2020) *Patterns* 1:100035. Random-matrix noise and sparsity-induced localisation in scRNA-seq.
